what: Mistake: accepted job 20261024-115923-02gf's plan, whose pr_commits (land.rs) requires exactly one Athena-Job trailer on every commit between the remote base and the PR head; my own commits (lease renewals, BRIEF relays, decisions) and declared interventions have none, so athena land --pr refused every pull request from 29fdd4c on, starting with job 20261024-114125-7z2t, and it reads commit-message trailers, which Sri asked not to depend on.
why: The plan's reviewers should test a landing against a realistic branch (records-only commits, owner-path commits, interventions between the base and the head), not only job commits; a fixture built from this repository's own recent PR ranges would have caught it.
